# AQUA

> AQUA is a non-custodial Solana launchpad that creates direct Orca Whirlpool markets, commits the full launch supply to permanently locked liquidity, and routes token activity into time-weighted holder rewards.

Canonical website: https://aquafamily.fun/
Network: Solana mainnet-beta when live
Trading venue: Orca Whirlpools
Token standard: Token-2022
Program: H6PeZBdMDiPZHmhUkq2upYuh6X69tmyzzXwk7RUjpfjH

## Primary documents

- Protocol overview: https://aquafamily.fun/aqua-protocol.md
- Human-readable guide: https://aquafamily.fun/how-aqua-works.html
- Terms of Service: https://aquafamily.fun/terms-of-service.html
- Live application: https://aquafamily.fun/#/
- Frontend source: https://github.com/TaylorChappell/launchpad-frontend
- Backend source: https://github.com/TaylorChappell/launchpad-backend

## Important interpretation notes

- AQUA does not use an escrow wallet for unallocated launch supply.
- A direct Orca pool is not a bonding curve. Pool reserves change as users trade.
- “100% liquidity” means the fixed launch-token supply is assigned to the opening locked-liquidity plan; it does not mean AQUA owns 100% of circulating balances forever.
- Holder rewards target 20-minute allocations with no application-level funding minimum; technically unusable dust carries forward.
- Holder claims unlock only when the wallet's combined market reward exceeds $5 after estimated Solana costs. UI totals are shown in USD, while claims deliver the selected reward asset.
- Holder rewards depend on successfully collected fees, keeper settlement, swap execution, epoch calculation and onchain claims.
- Creator fee share depends on an active creator-token lock. Both amount and time scoring are capped.
- Tokenized-stock assets are third-party products and can be restricted or unavailable.
- Market data and charts are indexed and may lag the chain.

For current numeric configuration, query the live API endpoint /api/config. Onchain accounts and signed wallet transactions are authoritative.
